diagnosis.old_core_binding_observation: The frozen core assigned tau = incidence verified TD upper bound, used that tau in the BA25 resource guard, and then passed claimed_tau=tau when validating the extended BA25 factor TD.

constructed_supplied_td_width_lemma.precondition: The frozen extender returns a well-formed T_F from the supplied T_I and the actual embedded instance dimensions.

proof_by_construction.original_incidence_bags: Every original incidence bag is transformed only by node-name mapping x_i->v:x_i and c_j->C:j, preserving cardinality exactly.
proof_by_construction.variable_block_leaf_bags: For each source variable i, the extender adds block_leaf:i = {v:x_i, B:i+1}, cardinality 2, width contribution 1.
proof_by_construction.z_support_block_bag: The extender adds z:block = {B:0, v:z}, cardinality 2, width contribution 1.
proof_by_construction.z_support_clause_bag: The extender adds z:clause = {v:z, C:clause_count}, cardinality 2, width contribution 1.
proof_by_construction.maximum_bag_cardinality_relation: max_bag_size(T_F) = max(max_bag_size(T_I), 2) for nonempty T_I; under the frozen empty-incidence convention u_I=-1, the added size-2 support bags give u_F=1.
proof_by_construction.width_relation: Since WIDTH(T)=max_B |B|-1, the supplied constructed TD obeys u_F=max(u_I,1).

constructed_supplied_td_width_lemma.forbidden_promotion: tw(G_F) = max(tw(G_I), 1) is NOT asserted by this object

INCIDENCE_TD_VERIFIED_UB.meaning: Width of the independently validated supplied incidence TD; a rigorous incidence-treewidth upper bound, not automatically exact treewidth.

INCIDENCE_TW_LB.meaning: Replayable lower bound on residual incidence-graph treewidth from the already-frozen incidence-width machinery.

BA25_FACTOR_TD_VERIFIED_WIDTH.meaning: Actual width max_B |B|-1 of the independently validated supplied BA25 factor TD.

BA25_FACTOR_TD_VALIDATION_PASS.meaning: Independent tree, vertex coverage, edge coverage, running-intersection and actual-width validation on the actual BA25 factor graph and supplied factor TD.

permanent_parameter_names.rule: Bare ambiguous tau must not cross the incidence-graph to BA25-factor-graph boundary in future USF evidence.

ordered_steps: Construct the BA25 factor graph from the actual residual embedding.
Construct T_F by the exact frozen extend_incidence_td_to_ba25 extender from the already independently validated incidence T_I.
Independently validate T_F against the actual BA25 factor graph: tree, vertex coverage, edge coverage, running intersection.
Independently derive BA25_FACTOR_TD_VERIFIED_WIDTH = max_B |B|-1 from the supplied T_F itself.
Assert the frozen construction relation BA25_FACTOR_TD_VERIFIED_WIDTH = max(INCIDENCE_TD_VERIFIED_UB, 1).
Only if both the independent factor-TD validation and the frozen construction-width relation pass, supply claimed_tau = BA25_FACTOR_TD_VERIFIED_WIDTH to BA25 validation/runtime plumbing.

resource_guard_parameter_domain.existing_ba25_engine_observation: The frozen BA25 run_dp independently validates its supplied TD, reads the resulting TD width, and emits state_bound = 2^(tau+2).
resource_guard_parameter_domain.asymptotic_constant_floor_observation: If a future proof established u_I=O(log n), then the frozen supplied-TD lift u_F=max(u_I,1) would also be O(log n).

generic_anti_post_hoc_rule.motivating_counterexample: A1 UNSAT n=32 had incidence supplied TD width 0 and BA25 factor supplied TD actual width 1.
generic_anti_post_hoc_rule.forbidden_repair: if A1 UNSAT n=32 then claimed_tau=1
generic_anti_post_hoc_rule.required_generic_rule: For every future residual, independently construct and validate the actual factor TD, derive its actual width from its bags, verify the frozen lift relation, then bind BA25 to that factor-TD width.

diagnostic_classification_hardening.preserved_v2_wrapper_observation: V2 emitted generic REDUCER_REPLAY_FAILURE when the canonical entrypoint exited nonzero before a complete record existed.
diagnostic_classification_hardening.future_execution_wrapper_requirement: Retain exact exception stage / causal stage so a later-stage failure cannot be mislabeled as reducer failure merely because no complete instance record was emitted.
